contradictions.topic: Cmd+T: three claimants (add text track in code / new video track in UX-SPEC / Free Transform in Dimensional PRD)

contradictions.topic: Slide semantics: pattern says previous neighbour absorbs; code needs both neighbours and resizes both

a.claim: Slide shortens/extends the previous item and refuses when media runs out. (E5: Matches Creatrix slideClip(..., prevSourceLength))

b.claim: if (!prev || !next) return   (prev extends/shrinks AND next shrinks/extends from its head; first or last clip of a run: silent no-op)

contradictions.recommendation: Spec the real verb from code: both flush neighbours required, no feedback when refused. Add a refused-edit toast or relax to prev-only per OTIO; owner call. Clip.tsx:388 comment ('next shifts') is also inexact.

contradictions.topic: D3 'never the header' vs legacy (flag-OFF) track header with opacity slider and blend Select

a.claim: Deep controls (blend/opacity/matte/transform) live in the panel, never the header.

b.claim: <Select className="track-header__blend" ...> plus track-header__opacity slider at :592 in the legacy two-row header (renders when FF.F_CREATRIX_LAYOUT is false)

contradictions.recommendation: Flag defaults ON (app-creatrix-default-on.test.tsx), so reachable only by override. Delete the legacy header in the flag-flip cleanup (PLANNING-QUEUE 'dead legacy TrackHeader flag-flip') to make D3 unconditional.

contradictions.topic: sampler-clip-editor makes clips HTML5-draggable; clip body already owns a pointer-event move drag

a.claim: `Clip.tsx`: `draggable` when NOT in a resize/trim pointer interaction; `dataTransfer` type `application/x-creatrix-clip-source`

b.claim: pointerdown selects the clip and installs document pointermove handlers that move the clip (moveHandler :487); move-drag is not excluded by the plan

contradictions.recommendation: Plan only excludes resize/trim. Needs a rule for plain move (modifier or handle) or native dragstart will cancel the pointer drag; see patterns/drag-drop.md Problem 4.

openQuestions.question: When a track has a visible automation lane, should plain drag on the bed make a time selection (D12) or an automation-point marquee? What gesture wins, and does Draw mode suspend D12?
Is z-order law (D2) meant to cover text, performance (sampler/rack) and frozen layers? If yes, App.tsx layer assembly must change; if no, ratify the exception.
Should the transport loop button and loopRegion be one mechanism (loop plays the region when set, whole timeline otherwise)?
Is 'loop brace independently draggable' (D12, OD-2) a requirement to build or wording to correct? Same for marker drag.
Should slide refuse silently, toast, or relax to previous-neighbour-only? And should rippleTrimClipOut get a UI (modifier on trim-out) or be deleted?
Text tracks: ratify the shipped behaviors (Cmd+T, click-to-place 5s clip, overlay drag, TextPanel) or send A15 through a plan? Should the text track expose blend/opacity at all?
Master/duplicate: add a store-level master guard in duplicateTrack (as removeTrack has) even though no UI path exists today?
Coverage caveat: design.md and tasks.md of openspec 01/02/03 were not read (proposals only); their D-rows may add claims on selection or track lifecycle not checked here.
Is the 'inspector' track (rename to Scope, OD-1) a Track=Layer member given it never composites and has no clips?
